name: PatientSupportProgramEnrolment
tagline: From referral to first shipment and beyond – consent, benefits verification, prior authorization, compliant financial assistance and non-clinical adherence follow-ups in one hub app.
description: Complete patient support programme (hub) app for specialty-medicine manufacturers and their hub partners. Take every patient from referral through consent, benefits verification, prior authorization and financial assistance to the first specialty-pharmacy shipment, then run non-clinical adherence follow-ups and refill reminders. Built-in guardrails block copay cards for government-insured patients, check free-drug eligibility, track consent validity and force a pharmacovigilance hand-off whenever a possible adverse event is mentioned. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with fictional demo data out of the box. Not a medical device – no clinical advice.
features: Referral intake with first-contact SLA and duplicate checks
Consent / HIPAA authorization gate with validity tracking
Benefits verification and prior authorization tracking with re-authorization warnings
Rule-checked financial assistance: copay card, foundation referral, free drug (PAP), bridge supply
No copay cards for Medicare / Medicaid / government insurance
Non-clinical adherence follow-ups and refill-late flags
AE / PQC mention forces a pharmacovigilance hand-off (OnAction event)
Drag-and-drop journey board with enforced rules
Bulk assign, schedule, move, export; undo; phone layout
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
